title: Engine Data — isolation / DB signals (REL-8.2 verified)
description: Isolation and slow-query signals. The RLS-violation critical alert fires on neryva_engine_rls_violations_total (registry-reserved; emitted by the RLS harness path — wire a runtime emitter before relying on it beyond CI). DB pool has no engine gauge: use the managed-Postgres exporter, not an invented series (the old neryva_engine_pg_pool_* placeholder panel is removed — it never existed).
notes: Reserved-but-unemitted names (no panel until a call site lands): neryva_engine_lock_waits_total, neryva_engine_slow_queries_total, neryva_engine_outbox_lag_seconds, neryva_engine_dead_letters_total (the dispatcher emits the unprefixed outbox_* equivalents — use those).
